paper_span.quote: Since each unordered unit segment has at most two orientations,

decls.rationale: The counting identity used at the end of Lemma 2.5: the number of *ordered* pairs of distinct points at distance 1 is exactly twice the unordered count \(\nu\), since each unit segment has two orientations.

decls.name: Lemma25PlanarCount
decls.rationale: Lemma 2.5, part 2: the projected planar set satisfies \(\nu(P) \ge \tfrac12 e^{\gamma f/2}|P|\) — each ordered pair counted by \(E_a\) projects to a unit segment, and each unordered segment is counted at most twice.
